assumptions.opening_angle_status: user-approved planning baseline, not a Q4 statement fact
assumptions.terrain_status: historical grid used as current planning baseline
assumptions.formal_length: sum of line segments inside the target region
assumptions.over20_counting: per ordered adjacent pair; the current line segment is counted once per exceeding neighbor pair, so a segment may be counted twice if both sides exceed

selection.criterion: lexicographic: miss, then pair-counted over-20 length, then total length

random_seed: not applicable; deterministic candidate generation and evaluation
